Suitcase Carry — one side one lap

infoText.about: Showing up is the goal. After 50, consistency is more important than sets or reps. Keep moving, stay injury-free, feel good doing it.
infoText.setsAndReps: I usually do 3 sets with a 1/2 weight add-on finisher. Somewhere between 10 and 15 reps where the last few feel like work but form never breaks. Rest usually 2 minutes per set.
infoText.floor: Three movements per session. Primary option first, alternative after the slash — use whichever is free. No supersets, no circuits. Do your sets, rest, move on.
infoText.burnout: Optional. Drop your main compound to 50–60% of working weight and take it to failure. Aim for 20–30 reps. Maintains muscle without heavy loading.
infoText.mat: Over time you should develop your own stretch and core routine using the suggestions here. What we suggest here augments what you already know. The hamstring stretch is a daily constant. Everything else rotates. Props are always optional.
infoText.whenToGo: No streaks. No guilt. The app picks up exactly where you left off — tomorrow or next week, it does not matter.

rules.moveOn: Hit the target with clean form 2 sessions in a row.
rules.regress: Pain, a giving-out feeling, form breaking down, or can't reach the bottom of the range. Also regress if you have to arch your back to reach the position.

phases.name: Phase 1: Shoulder Foundation
phases.goal: Left cuff strength, right shoulder range, safe pressing, core and hamstrings. Worth doing for its own sake.
warmup: Wrist rocks on all fours: 10 fingers forward, 10 back
Band external rotations, light band: 2 x 15 each arm
Wrist push-ups (rock up onto fingers): 2 x 10
Right shoulder: lying dowel overhead reach, ribs down: 10

ladders.name: Mat · Plank progression
ladders.cue: Push the floor away. Stop before the shoulder starts to give.

steps.name: Floor plank: 30s hold, then 10 weight shifts
steps.dose: 3 sets · TIP: shift slowly, hips stay level

steps.name: Floor plank: 30s hold, then 6 fingertip hovers each side (palm up onto fingertips, then lift 1 inch)
steps.dose: 3 sets · TIP: palm lifts first, fingertips stay down
steps.tip: palm lifts first, fingertips stay down

steps.name: Floor plank: 20s hold, then 6 shoulder taps each side
steps.dose: 3 sets · TIP: widen feet if hips rock

steps.name: Feet on the low bar (~4"): 20s hold, then 6 shoulder taps each side
steps.dose: 3 sets · NEEDS LOW BAR · TIP: toes on bar, body one straight line
steps.tip: toes on bar, body one straight line

steps.name: Feet on foam roller on the low bar, wedged against the wall (~10"): 20s hold, then 6 shoulder taps each side
steps.dose: 3 sets · NEEDS FOAM ROLLER + LOW BAR + WALL · TIP: test the roller with one foot first
steps.tip: test the roller with one foot first

steps.name: Feet on wall at 1 ft: 20s hold only
steps.dose: 3 sets · NEEDS WALL · TIP: press toes into the wall, just hold
steps.tip: press toes into the wall, just hold

steps.name: Feet on wall at 1 ft: 20s hold, then 6 shoulder taps each side
steps.dose: 3 sets · NEEDS WALL · TIP: hands stay planted, only one hand lifts
steps.tip: hands stay planted, only one hand lifts

steps.name: Feet on wall at 2 ft: 20s hold, then 4 shoulder taps each side
steps.dose: 3 sets · NEEDS WALL · TIP: fewer taps, slower taps

steps.name: Feet on wall at 3 ft: 20s hold, then 3 shoulder taps each side
steps.dose: 3 sets · NEEDS WALL · TIP: graduation: walk feet down, never drop
steps.tip: graduation: walk feet down, never drop

ladders.cueFull: Hold first, then the single-arm work in the same set. On the wall: back your feet up and place your toes at the mark, press toes into the wall, hands stay planted. Shift weight slowly, grip the floor, stop before the shoulder gives. Wall marks at 1, 2 and 3 ft (tape or wall features). Roller step: press it with a foot first to check it's wedged before putting weight on it. Have a medicine ball? Rolling it under one hand works for the fingertip-hover step too.

ladders.name: Mat · Pike push-ups
ladders.cue: Head lands in front of hands. Elbows back at 45°.

steps.name: Kneeling pike push-ups
steps.dose: 3 x 5-8 · TIP: hips high, weight forward over hands
steps.tip: hips high, weight forward over hands

steps.name: Pike push-up negatives (3-4s lower)
steps.dose: 3 x 3-5 · TIP: slow 3-4s down, use knees to get back up
steps.tip: slow 3-4s down, use knees to get back up

steps.name: Knee-drop pike push-ups: lower in pike, knees drop at the bottom, press up from knees, lift back into pike
steps.dose: 3 x 5 · TIP: knees land softly, press through hands
steps.tip: knees land softly, press through hands

steps.name: Partial pike push-ups
steps.dose: 3 x 5 · TIP: lower halfway, then press

steps.name: Full pike push-ups
steps.dose: 3 x 5 · TIP: head lightly touches, no bouncing

ladders.cueFull: Head lands slightly in front of hands, elbows back at 45°. Tight hamstrings: bend your knees a little so your back stays flat and arms stay in line with your ears. Legs straighten as flexibility improves. Ribs down: if your back arches to get your arms overhead, bring your hands forward. Your right shoulder has less range; don't force it.

ladders.name: Machines · Dip support hold
ladders.cue: Arms locked, shoulders pushed down. Use the steps, no jumping.

steps.name: Support hold, feet lightly on floor
steps.dose: 3 x 10-20s · NEEDS DIP BARS · TIP: feet take a little weight

steps.name: Dip support hold
steps.dose: 3 x 20s · NEEDS DIP BARS · TIP: squeeze the bars, stay tall

ladders.cueFull: Shoulders pushed down, away from ears. No jumping: use the station's built-in steps to get into position.

ladders.name: Machines · Assisted dips
ladders.cue: Less weight on the stack = harder. Only as deep as feels stable.

steps.name: Assisted dip machine, heavy assist
steps.dose: 3 x 8 · NEEDS DIP MACHINE · TIP: smooth reps, shoulders down

steps.name: Assisted dip machine, moderate assist
steps.dose: 3 x 6 · NEEDS DIP MACHINE · TIP: elbows track back, not out

steps.name: Assisted dip machine, moderate assist, 3s lowering
steps.dose: 3 x 6 · NEEDS DIP MACHINE · TIP: 3s down, steady push up

ladders.cueFull: Kneel or stand on the pad. Shoulders pushed down away from your ears, only go as deep as feels stable. Less weight on the stack = harder.

ladders.name: Bench · Half-kneeling dumbbell press
ladders.cue: Half-kneeling. Press only as high as ribs stay down.

steps.name: 15 lb dumbbell
steps.dose: 3 x 8 each arm · NEEDS DUMBBELL · TIP: right arm may stop short of vertical
steps.tip: right arm may stop short of vertical

steps.name: 20 lb dumbbell
steps.dose: 3 x 8 each arm · NEEDS DUMBBELL · TIP: squeeze the glute of the down knee
steps.tip: squeeze the glute of the down knee

steps.name: 25 lb dumbbell
steps.dose: 3 x 6 each arm · NEEDS DUMBBELL · TIP: control the lowering

ladders.cueFull: Half-kneeling, one arm at a time. Press only as high as your ribs stay down; stop before your back arches. The right arm may stop short of vertical, that's fine.

ladders.name: Bench · Single-arm overhead hold
ladders.cue: One arm at a time. Hold only as high as your back stays flat.

steps.name: Half-kneeling hold, 5–10 lb dumbbell
steps.dose: 3 x 15s each arm · NEEDS DUMBBELL · TIP: arm in front of your ear is fine
steps.tip: arm in front of your ear is fine

steps.name: Half-kneeling hold, 10–15 lb dumbbell
steps.dose: 3 x 20s each arm · NEEDS DUMBBELL · TIP: add 5 lb only with zero wobble
steps.tip: add 5 lb only with zero wobble

ladders.cueFull: One arm at a time. Hold only as high as your ribs stay down; the right arm may sit in front of your ear. Add 5 lb only with zero wobble and no arch.

ladders.name: Mat · Hollow hold
ladders.cue: Lower back pressed to the floor. Shorten before you arch.

steps.name: Dead bugs only
steps.dose: 2 x 8 each side · TIP: opposite arm and leg, slow

steps.name: Tuck hollow hold
steps.dose: 3 x 20-30s · TIP: knees to chest, shoulders lifted

steps.name: One-leg hollow
steps.dose: 3 x 20-30s · TIP: switch the long leg each set
steps.tip: switch the long leg each set

steps.name: Bent-knee hollow, arms overhead
steps.dose: 3 x 20-30s · TIP: arms by ears, knees bent

steps.name: Full hollow hold
steps.dose: 3 x 30s, flat back · TIP: exhale, ribs down, toes pointed

ladders.cueFull: Exhale, ribs down. Shorten the hold before letting the back arch.

ladders.name: Machines · Inverted rows
ladders.cue: Body straight, chest to the bar.

steps.name: Rows, bar at chest height
steps.dose: 3 x 8 · NEEDS BAR · TIP: squeeze shoulder blades together

steps.name: Rows, bar at waist height
steps.dose: 3 x 8 · NEEDS BAR · TIP: walk feet forward a little

steps.name: Rows, bar at hip height
steps.dose: 3 x 8 · NEEDS BAR · TIP: pause 1s at the top

ladders.cueFull: Body straight, pull chest to the bar, squeeze shoulder blades together.

ladders.name: Machines · Pulldown → assisted pull-ups
ladders.cue: Shoulders down first, then pull. Step up, never jump.

steps.name: Lat pulldown, moderate weight
steps.dose: 3 x 10 · NEEDS PULLDOWN · TIP: pull bar to upper chest

steps.name: Lat pulldown, heavier
steps.dose: 3 x 8 · NEEDS PULLDOWN · TIP: control 2s on the way up

steps.name: Assisted pull-up machine, heavy assist
steps.dose: 3 x 6 · NEEDS ASSIST MACHINE · TIP: step onto the platform, 3s lower

ladders.cueFull: No jumping. Step up onto the machine's platform to reach the bar. Shoulders pulled down first, then pull with the arms. Lower slowly.

ladders.name: Bench · Y-T-W raises
ladders.cue: Face down on incline bench. Slow, thumbs up.

steps.name: Face down on incline bench, no weight
steps.dose: 2 x 8 each letter · NEEDS BENCH · TIP: learn the shapes, no weight

steps.name: 2.5 lb dumbbells
steps.dose: 2 x 8 each letter · NEEDS BENCH + DUMBBELL · TIP: squeeze shoulder blades each rep

steps.name: 5 lb dumbbells
steps.dose: 2 x 8 each letter · NEEDS BENCH + DUMBBELL · TIP: stop if the left shoulder pinches
steps.tip: stop if the left shoulder pinches

ladders.cueFull: Slow, thumbs up, squeeze the shoulder blades. Shoulder stability without hanging. Ribs down: if your back arches to get your arms overhead, bring your hands forward. Your right shoulder has less range; don't force it.

ladders.name: Mat · Side plank (forearm)
ladders.cue: Elbow under shoulder, hips high.

steps.name: Knees down
steps.dose: 3 x 20s each side · TIP: knees bent, hips forward

steps.name: Full side plank
steps.dose: 3 x 20s each side · TIP: stack feet or stagger them

steps.name: Full side plank
steps.dose: 3 x 30s each side · TIP: body one straight line

ladders.cueFull: Elbow under shoulder, hips high, body in one line.

ladders.name: Machines · Supported hang
ladders.cue: Feet stay on floor. Shoulders active, never sink.

steps.name: Supported hang, most weight on feet
steps.dose: 3 x 20s · NEEDS BAR · TIP: lean back gently, banana shape

steps.name: Supported hang, less weight on feet
steps.dose: 3 x 20s · NEEDS BAR · TIP: feet take less, shoulders still active
steps.tip: feet take less, shoulders still active

steps.name: Supported scap pulls, feet on floor
steps.dose: 3 x 8 · NEEDS BAR · TIP: arms straight, only shoulder blades move
steps.tip: arms straight, only shoulder blades move

ladders.cueFull: Bar about head height, feet stay on the floor, lean back into a long banana stretch. Take as much weight on your feet as you need. Shoulders stay active, not dangling. Ribs down: if your back arches to get your arms overhead, bring your hands forward. Your right shoulder has less range; don't force it. Left shoulder: stay active, never sink into the stretch.

ladders.name: Mat · Forearm headstand prep
ladders.cue: Forearms carry the weight. Head hangs off the floor, back long. Any neck pain: stop.

steps.name: Forearm plank
steps.dose: 3 x 30s · TIP: elbows under shoulders

steps.name: Dolphin hold (forearm down-dog, hips high)
steps.dose: 3 x 20s · TIP: head off the floor, bend knees to keep back flat
steps.tip: head off the floor, bend knees to keep back flat

steps.name: Dolphin hold, feet walked in a little
steps.dose: 3 x 20s · TIP: walk in only as far as back stays flat
steps.tip: walk in only as far as back stays flat

steps.name: Dolphin hold, feet walked in, shoulders over elbows
steps.dose: 3 x 30s · TIP: push the floor away, don't sink between shoulders
steps.tip: push the floor away, don't sink between shoulders

ladders.cueFull: Elbows shoulder-width, press forearms into the floor and push the chest toward your legs. Tight hamstrings: bend your knees a little so your back stays flat and arms stay in line with your ears. Legs straighten as flexibility improves. Ribs down: if your back arches to get your arms overhead, bring your hands forward. Your right shoulder has less range; don't force it.

ladders.name: Mat · Ball rollout
ladders.cue: Ribs down, glutes tight. Roll only as far as your back stays flat.

steps.name: Kneeling, forearms on ball, short roll out
steps.dose: 3 x 8 · NEEDS BALL · TIP: small range, smooth return

steps.name: Kneeling, roll out further
steps.dose: 3 x 8 · NEEDS BALL · TIP: a few inches further

steps.name: Kneeling, roll out until arms are overhead
steps.dose: 3 x 8 · NEEDS BALL · TIP: graduation: arms overhead, back still flat
steps.tip: graduation: arms overhead, back still flat

ladders.cueFull: Ribs down, glutes squeezed, back flat. Only roll as far as you can without your lower back sagging. Ab wheel instead? It's much harder: only after full ball rollouts, kneeling, rolling toward a wall to limit range.

ladders.name: Mat · Slow leg lowers
ladders.cue: Lower back stays pressed down.

steps.name: Reverse crunch, 3s lowering
steps.dose: 3 x 6 · TIP: knees curl in, 3s lowering

steps.name: Bent-knee leg lowers, tap heels
steps.dose: 3 x 8 · TIP: tap heels, keep the back flat
steps.tip: tap heels, keep the back flat

steps.name: Single straight-leg lowers
steps.dose: 3 x 6 each · TIP: other knee bent, foot on floor
steps.tip: other knee bent, foot on floor

steps.name: Both straight legs, 4s lower
steps.dose: 3 x 6 · TIP: lower only as far as back stays down
steps.tip: lower only as far as back stays down

ladders.cueFull: Lower back pressed into the floor. Only lower as far as you can without it lifting. This trains the controlled lowering for donkey kicks.

ladders.name: Mat · Hamstrings & pike stretch
ladders.cue: Gentle, never bounce. Back stays long.

steps.name: Lying hamstring stretch with band, other leg flat
steps.dose: 2 x 30s each leg · NEEDS BAND · TIP: other leg flat on the floor
steps.tip: other leg flat on the floor

steps.name: Band stretch + contract-relax: press leg into band 5s, relax, ease deeper
steps.dose: 3 rounds each leg · NEEDS BAND · TIP: press 5s, relax, ease deeper

steps.name: Standing pike fold, knees soft, flat back, hands to shins
steps.dose: 2 x 30s · TIP: bend knees as much as needed
steps.tip: bend knees as much as needed

steps.name: Seated pike fold, flat back, contract-relax
steps.dose: 3 rounds · TIP: lead with the chest

ladders.cueFull: Gentle, never bounce. Lead with the chest and keep the back long. Progress comes over months, not sessions.

ladders.name: Mat · Right shoulder mobility
ladders.cue: Right shoulder. Gentle, never force. Stop when your back arches.

steps.name: Foam roller upper-back extension + child's pose lat stretch
steps.dose: 2 x 8 / 2 x 30s · NEEDS FOAM ROLLER · TIP: roller under shoulder blades

steps.name: Add: lying dowel overhead reach, ribs down
steps.dose: 2 x 10 · NEEDS FOAM ROLLER + DOWEL · TIP: dowel up only as far as ribs stay down
steps.tip: dowel up only as far as ribs stay down

steps.name: Add: right cross-body stretch and sleeper stretch
steps.dose: 2 x 30s each · NEEDS FOAM ROLLER + DOWEL · TIP: right arm only, gentle

steps.name: Add: kneeling bench prayer stretch (elbows on bench, sit back)
steps.dose: 2 x 30s · NEEDS FOAM ROLLER + DOWEL + BENCH · TIP: sit back slowly, hold

steps.name: Full routine, then wall slides ribs down, right arm a little higher each week
steps.dose: 2 x 10 · NEEDS FOAM ROLLER + DOWEL + BENCH + WALL · TIP: a little higher each week

ladders.cueFull: Right (repaired) shoulder. Slow, gentle, never force or bounce. Ribs down and lower back flat: the moment your back arches, you've reached your real range. Left shoulder: do the upper-back and lat parts, but skip the end-range shoulder stretches on that side.

ladders.name: Mat · Left shoulder stability
ladders.cue: Left shoulder: strength, not stretch. Light and slow.

steps.name: Side-lying external rotation, 2-3 lb dumbbell
steps.dose: 3 x 12 · NEEDS DUMBBELL · TIP: elbow pinned to your side

steps.name: Add: lying serratus punch (press up, reach the ceiling), 5-8 lb
steps.dose: 3 x 12 · NEEDS DUMBBELL · TIP: reach the ceiling, don't shrug

steps.name: Add: bottoms-up kettlebell hold, light, elbow bent 90°
steps.dose: 3 x 20s · NEEDS DUMBBELL + KETTLEBELL · TIP: bell upside down, wrist straight

steps.name: Bottoms-up kettlebell carry, light
steps.dose: 3 x 20 steps · NEEDS KETTLEBELL · TIP: walk slowly, keep the bell still
steps.tip: walk slowly, keep the bell still

ladders.cueFull: Left shoulder (past dislocations): strength, not stretch. Light weight, slow, perfect control. Avoid the arm out to the side and rotated back position, and never hang or stretch into end range on this side.

ladders.name: Mat · Pike hold + shrugs
ladders.cue: Hold, then shrug in the same set. Elbows locked.

steps.name: Kneeling pike: 20s hold, then 10 kneeling shrugs
steps.dose: 3 sets · TIP: ears between biceps

steps.name: Bent-knee pike: 20s hold, then 8 shrugs
steps.dose: 3 sets · TIP: full shrug range, pause at the top
steps.tip: full shrug range, pause at the top

steps.name: Full pike: 30s hold, then 10 shrugs
steps.dose: 3 sets · TIP: bend knees if hamstrings pull

ladders.cueFull: Hold first, then shrug in the same set. Ears between biceps, elbows locked, full shrug range with a pause at the top. Tight hamstrings: bend your knees a little so your back stays flat. Ribs down: if your back arches to get your arms overhead, bring your hands forward. Your right shoulder has less range; don't force it.

ladders.name: Mat · Glute bridge
ladders.cue: Ribs down, tuck the pelvis at the top. Squeeze glutes, don't arch your back.

steps.name: Glute bridge, 2s squeeze at top
steps.dose: 3 x 12 · TIP: push through heels

steps.name: Banded glute bridge (band above knees)
steps.tip: knees push out into the band
steps.dose: 3 x 12 · NEEDS BAND · TIP: knees push out into the band

steps.name: Single-leg glute bridge
steps.dose: 3 x 10 each · TIP: hips stay level

steps.name: Single-leg glute bridge, 3s hold at top
steps.dose: 3 x 10 each · TIP: graduation: slow and level

ladders.name: Mat · Side glutes
ladders.cue: Hips stacked, slight forward tilt of the top hip. Slow.

steps.name: Clamshell
steps.dose: 3 x 15 each · TIP: heels together, knee opens

steps.name: Banded clamshell
steps.dose: 3 x 15 each · NEEDS BAND · TIP: don't roll backward

steps.name: Side-lying leg raise, toes slightly down
steps.dose: 3 x 12 each · TIP: lead with the heel

steps.name: Side plank (knees down) with top-leg lift
steps.dose: 3 x 8 each · TIP: hips high the whole time

ladders.name: Bench · Hip thrust
ladders.cue: Ribs down, tuck the pelvis at the top. Squeeze glutes, don't arch your back. Upper back on the bench edge.

steps.name: Bodyweight hip thrust
steps.dose: 3 x 12 · NEEDS BENCH · TIP: chin tucked, eyes forward

steps.name: Hip thrust, 25 lb dumbbell on hips
steps.tip: pad the dumbbell with a towel
steps.dose: 3 x 10 · NEEDS BENCH + DUMBBELL · TIP: pad the dumbbell with a towel

steps.name: Hip thrust, 40 lb dumbbell on hips
steps.dose: 3 x 10 · NEEDS BENCH + DUMBBELL · TIP: pause 1s at the top

steps.name: Single-leg hip thrust, bodyweight
steps.dose: 3 x 10 each · NEEDS BENCH · TIP: graduation: hips stay level

ladders.name: Bench · Split squat

steps.name: Split squat, bodyweight, hand on bench for balance

steps.dose: 3 x 8 each · NEEDS DUMBBELL · TIP: torso leans slightly forward

steps.dose: 3 x 8 each · NEEDS BENCH · TIP: front foot far enough forward

steps.name: Rear-foot-elevated split squat, 15 lb dumbbells
steps.dose: 3 x 8 each · NEEDS BENCH + DUMBBELL · TIP: graduation: slow, controlled

ladders.name: Bench · Single-leg Romanian deadlift
ladders.cue: Hinge at the hip, back flat. Feel it in the standing-leg glute and hamstring.

steps.name: Single-leg RDL, hand on wall, bodyweight
steps.dose: 3 x 8 each · NEEDS WALL · TIP: soft knee, hips square

steps.name: Single-leg RDL, hand on wall, dumbbell in other hand
steps.dose: 3 x 8 each · NEEDS WALL + DUMBBELL · TIP: weight hangs straight down

steps.name: Single-leg RDL, free-standing, dumbbell

steps.name: Glute kickback machine, light

steps.dose: 3 x 12 each · NEEDS GLUTE MACHINE · TIP: find the seat and pad settings

steps.name: Glute kickback machine, moderate
steps.dose: 3 x 12 each · NEEDS GLUTE MACHINE · TIP: 1s squeeze at the top

steps.name: Glute kickback machine, heavier, slow 3s return

ladders.name: Mat · Wall holds
ladders.cue: Hands planted first. Only your feet walk up and down.

steps.name: Feet at 3 ft on the wall
steps.dose: 3 x 30s · NEEDS WALL · TIP: longer hold at a familiar height

steps.tip: hips over hands, legs along the wall

Tight hamstrings: bend your knees a little so your back stays flat and arms stay in line with your ears. Legs straighten as flexibility improves. steps.name: Wall L-pike push-ups, hips over hands
steps.dose: 3 x 3 · NEEDS WALL · TIP: graduation: hips over hands, slow

ladders.cueFull: Head lands slightly in front of hands, elbows back at 45°. Wall heights: tape marks (or wall features) at 1 ft, 1.5 ft, 2 ft, 3 ft and 4 ft. Tight hamstrings: bend your knees a little so your back stays flat and arms stay in line with your ears. Legs straighten as flexibility improves. Ribs down: if your back arches to get your arms overhead, bring your hands forward. Your right shoulder has less range; don't force it.

ladders.name: Mat · Pike compression
ladders.cue: Sit tall, knees straight. Don't lean back.

steps.name: Single-leg lifts, hands by knees
steps.dose: 3 x 6 each · TIP: lift the heel an inch

steps.name: Single-leg lifts, hands by hips
steps.dose: 3 x 8 each · TIP: hands closer, harder

steps.name: Both legs, hands by knees
steps.dose: 3 x 8 · TIP: both heels lift together

steps.name: Both legs, hands by hips
steps.dose: 3 x 10 · TIP: graduation: hands by hips

ladders.cueFull: Sit tall, knees straight, lift the heel an inch or two without leaning back. Tight hamstrings: bend your knees a little so your back stays flat and arms stay in line with your ears. Legs straighten as flexibility improves.

ladders.name: Mat · Hollow body
ladders.cue: Lower back stays down.

steps.name: Full hollow hold
steps.dose: 3 x 30s · TIP: exhale, ribs down

steps.name: Full hollow hold
steps.dose: 3 x 45s · TIP: longer hold, same shape

steps.name: Hollow rocks
steps.dose: 3 x 10 · TIP: small rocks, keep the shape

ladders.cueFull: Lower back flat the whole time.

ladders.name: Machines · Dips
ladders.cue: Only as deep as feels stable. Use the steps, no jumping.

steps.name: Assisted dip machine, light assist, 3s lowering
steps.dose: 3 x 6 · NEEDS DIP MACHINE · TIP: light assist, 3s down

steps.name: Partial-range dips on bars
steps.dose: 3 x 3 · NEEDS DIP BARS · TIP: halfway down, press up

steps.name: Full dips on bars
steps.dose: 3 x 3 · NEEDS DIP BARS · TIP: graduation: full range, shoulders down

ladders.cueFull: Only as deep as feels stable. No jumping: use the station's built-in steps to get into position.

ladders.name: Bench · Half-kneeling dumbbell press
ladders.cue: Press only as high as ribs stay down.

steps.name: 25 lb dumbbell
steps.dose: 3 x 8 each arm · NEEDS DUMBBELL · TIP: half-kneeling, one arm

steps.name: 30 lb dumbbell
steps.dose: 3 x 6 each arm · NEEDS DUMBBELL · TIP: control the lowering

steps.name: Landmine press, standing, ribs down
steps.dose: 3 x 6 each arm · NEEDS BARBELL · TIP: angled press, easier on the shoulder
steps.tip: angled press, easier on the shoulder

ladders.cueFull: Half-kneeling, one arm at a time. Press only as high as your ribs stay down; stop before your back arches. The right arm may stop short of vertical, that's fine.

ladders.name: Bench · Single-arm overhead hold
ladders.cue: One arm at a time. Back stays flat.

steps.name: Standing hold, 15 lb dumbbell
steps.dose: 3 x 20s each arm · NEEDS DUMBBELL · TIP: no lean away from the weight
steps.tip: no lean away from the weight

steps.name: Overhead carry, 15–20 lb dumbbell
steps.dose: 20 steps each arm · NEEDS DUMBBELL · TIP: walk slowly, arm steady

ladders.cueFull: One arm at a time, no leaning. Ribs down: hold only as high as your back stays flat.

ladders.name: Machines · Tuck support → L-sit
ladders.cue: Arms locked, shoulders down. Use the steps, no jumping.

steps.name: Tuck support, one foot on floor
steps.dose: 3 x 10s · NEEDS DIP BARS · TIP: one foot helps balance

steps.name: Tuck support, both feet up
steps.dose: 3 x 10s · NEEDS DIP BARS · TIP: knees up, stay tall

steps.name: Tuck support
steps.dose: 3 x 20s · NEEDS DIP BARS · TIP: longer hold

steps.name: One-leg L-sit, switch legs each set
steps.dose: 3 x 10s · NEEDS DIP BARS · TIP: switch legs each set

ladders.cueFull: Parallettes or dip bars. Shoulders pushed down. No jumping: use the station's built-in steps to get into position.

ladders.name: Mat · Arch body hold
ladders.cue: Glutes squeezed, eyes on the floor.

steps.name: Superman hold, arms by sides
steps.dose: 3 x 20s · TIP: arms by sides, lift chest and legs
steps.tip: arms by sides, lift chest and legs

steps.name: Superman hold, arms overhead
steps.dose: 3 x 20s · TIP: arms overhead, as far as comfortable
steps.tip: arms overhead, as far as comfortable

steps.name: Superman hold, arms overhead
steps.dose: 3 x 30s · TIP: graduation: longer hold

ladders.cueFull: Squeeze glutes, look at the floor.

ladders.name: Machines · Inverted rows
ladders.cue: Body straight, chest to the bar.

steps.name: Rows, bar at hip height
steps.dose: 3 x 8 · NEEDS BAR · TIP: squeeze shoulder blades

steps.name: Rows, bar at hip height
steps.dose: 3 x 12 · NEEDS BAR · TIP: more reps, same form

steps.name: Rows, bar lowered, body nearly horizontal
steps.dose: 3 x 8 · NEEDS BAR · TIP: lower bar, harder

ladders.cueFull: Body straight, chest to the bar.

ladders.name: Machines · Assisted pull-ups
ladders.cue: Shoulders down first. Step up, never jump. 3s lowering.

steps.name: Assisted pull-up machine, heavy assist
steps.dose: 3 x 8 · NEEDS ASSIST MACHINE · TIP: heavy assist, full range

steps.name: Assisted pull-up machine, moderate assist
steps.dose: 3 x 6 · NEEDS ASSIST MACHINE · TIP: less assist, same control

steps.name: Assisted pull-up machine, light assist
steps.dose: 3 x 5 · NEEDS ASSIST MACHINE · TIP: graduation: light assist

ladders.cueFull: No jumping. Step up onto the machine's platform to reach the bar. Shoulders pulled down first, then pull with the arms. Lower slowly. Slow 3s lowering on each rep. Ribs down: if your back arches to get your arms overhead, bring your hands forward. Your right shoulder has less range; don't force it.

ladders.name: Bench · Y-T-W raises
ladders.cue: Slow, thumbs up.

steps.name: 5 lb dumbbells
steps.dose: 2 x 10 each letter · NEEDS BENCH + DUMBBELL · TIP: squeeze shoulder blades each rep

steps.name: 8 lb dumbbells
steps.dose: 2 x 8 each letter · NEEDS BENCH + DUMBBELL · TIP: stop if the left shoulder pinches
steps.tip: stop if the left shoulder pinches

ladders.cueFull: Slow and controlled. Ribs down: if your back arches to get your arms overhead, bring your hands forward. Your right shoulder has less range; don't force it.

ladders.name: Mat · Forearm headstand prep
ladders.cue: Forearms carry the weight. Any neck pain: stop.

steps.name: Dolphin push-ups (rock forward and back)
steps.dose: 3 x 6 · TIP: head stays off the floor, back long
steps.tip: head stays off the floor, back long

steps.name: Headstand setup: hands clasped, crown lightly on floor, knees down
steps.dose: 3 x 20s · TIP: crown barely touches, forearms press

steps.name: Headstand setup, walk feet in until hips over shoulders
steps.dose: 3 x 20s · TIP: lift head 1/2 inch to test

steps.name: Tucked lift at the wall, feet just off the floor
steps.dose: 3 x 5s · NEEDS WALL · TIP: back of head near wall, tiny lift
steps.tip: back of head near wall, tiny lift

ladders.cueFull: Forearms carry the weight, never your head and neck. Any neck pain: stop. Back of the head near the wall for the tuck. Tight hamstrings: bend your knees a little so your back stays flat and arms stay in line with your ears. Legs straighten as flexibility improves. Ribs down: if your back arches to get your arms overhead, bring your hands forward. Your right shoulder has less range; don't force it.

ladders.name: Mat · Hamstrings & pike stretch
ladders.cue: Gentle, never bounce. Back stays long.

steps.name: Seated pike fold, contract-relax
steps.dose: 3 rounds · TIP: press 5s, relax, ease deeper

steps.name: Elephant walks: standing pike, hands down, straighten one leg at a time
steps.dose: 2 x 10 each leg · TIP: straighten one leg at a time
steps.tip: straighten one leg at a time

steps.name: Seated pike fold, legs straight, chest toward thighs
steps.dose: 2 x 60s · TIP: lead with the chest

ladders.cueFull: Gentle, never bounce. Back stays long. Hands down on the floor, or on your shins if they don't reach.

ladders.name: Mat · Right shoulder mobility
ladders.cue: Right shoulder. Gentle, never force. Stop when your back arches.

steps.name: Full routine from Phase 1 + wall slides
steps.dose: 2 x 10 · NEEDS FOAM ROLLER + DOWEL + BENCH + WALL · TIP: full routine, then wall slides

steps.name: Add: dowel overhead reach standing at the wall, back flat
steps.dose: 2 x 10 · NEEDS FOAM ROLLER + DOWEL + BENCH + WALL · TIP: back flat against the wall

steps.name: Add: active overhead holds, right arm, back against wall, ribs down
steps.dose: 3 x 15s · NEEDS FOAM ROLLER + DOWEL + BENCH + WALL · TIP: arm hovers off the wall, ribs down
steps.tip: arm hovers off the wall, ribs down

ladders.cueFull: Right (repaired) shoulder. Slow, gentle, never force or bounce. Ribs down and lower back flat: the moment your back arches, you've reached your real range. Left shoulder: do the upper-back and lat parts, but skip the end-range shoulder stretches on that side.

ladders.name: Mat · Left shoulder stability
ladders.cue: Left shoulder: strength, not stretch. Light and slow.

steps.name: Bottoms-up kettlebell carry, light
steps.dose: 3 x 20 steps · NEEDS KETTLEBELL · TIP: bell upside down, walk slowly

steps.name: Bottoms-up kettlebell press, half-kneeling, ribs down
steps.dose: 3 x 6 · NEEDS KETTLEBELL · TIP: press only as high as ribs stay down
steps.tip: press only as high as ribs stay down

steps.name: Bottoms-up kettlebell press, slightly heavier
steps.dose: 3 x 6 · NEEDS KETTLEBELL · TIP: small jump in weight

ladders.cueFull: Left shoulder (past dislocations): strength, not stretch. Light weight, slow, perfect control. Avoid the arm out to the side and rotated back position, and never hang or stretch into end range on this side.

ladders.name: Mat · Pike hold + shrugs
ladders.cue: Hold, then shrug in the same set. Elbows locked.

steps.name: Full pike: 30s hold, then 10 shrugs
steps.dose: 3 sets · TIP: ears between biceps

steps.name: Feet walked in close: 20s hold, then 8 shrugs
steps.dose: 3 sets · TIP: feet closer to hands

steps.name: Feet on wall at 1 ft: 20s hold, then 8 shrugs
steps.dose: 3 sets · NEEDS WALL · TIP: feet at the 1 ft mark

steps.name: Feet on wall at 2 ft, hips high: 30s hold, then 10 shrugs
steps.dose: 3 sets · NEEDS WALL · TIP: hips high over hands

ladders.cueFull: Hold first, then shrug in the same set. Push tall, elbows locked. Tight hamstrings: bend your knees a little so your back stays flat. Ribs down: if your back arches to get your arms overhead, bring your hands forward. Your right shoulder has less range; don't force it.

ladders.name: Mat · Glute bridge
ladders.cue: Ribs down, tuck the pelvis at the top. Squeeze glutes, don't arch your back.

steps.name: Single-leg glute bridge, 3s hold at top
steps.dose: 3 x 10 each · TIP: hips stay level

steps.name: Single-leg bridge, foot on bench
steps.dose: 3 x 10 each · NEEDS BENCH · TIP: push through the heel

steps.name: Single-leg bridge, foot on ball
steps.dose: 3 x 8 each · NEEDS BALL · TIP: graduation: ball stays still

ladders.name: Mat · Side glutes
ladders.cue: Hips stacked. Slow.

steps.name: Side plank (knees down) with top-leg lift
steps.dose: 3 x 10 each · TIP: hips high

steps.name: Full side plank with top-leg lift
steps.dose: 3 x 6 each · TIP: body one straight line

steps.name: Banded lateral walk, band above knees
steps.dose: 3 x 12 steps each way · NEEDS BAND · TIP: graduation: stay low, toes forward

ladders.name: Bench · Hip thrust
ladders.cue: Ribs down, tuck the pelvis at the top. Squeeze glutes, don't arch your back. Upper back on the bench edge.

steps.name: Single-leg hip thrust, bodyweight
steps.dose: 3 x 12 each · NEEDS BENCH · TIP: hips stay level

steps.name: Barbell hip thrust, 65 lb, padded bar
steps.dose: 3 x 10 · NEEDS BENCH + BARBELL · TIP: chin tucked, ribs down

steps.name: Barbell hip thrust, 95 lb, padded bar
steps.dose: 3 x 8 · NEEDS BENCH + BARBELL · TIP: graduation: 1s pause at top

ladders.name: Bench · Split squat
ladders.cue: Lean slightly forward and push through the front heel.

steps.name: Rear-foot-elevated split squat, 20 lb dumbbells
steps.dose: 3 x 8 each · NEEDS BENCH + DUMBBELL · TIP: slow on the way down

steps.name: Rear-foot-elevated split squat, 25 lb dumbbells
steps.dose: 3 x 8 each · NEEDS BENCH + DUMBBELL · TIP: front knee tracks over toes

steps.name: Rear-foot-elevated split squat, 25 lb, 3s lowering
steps.dose: 3 x 8 each · NEEDS BENCH + DUMBBELL · TIP: graduation: steady and controlled

ladders.name: Bench · Single-leg Romanian deadlift
ladders.cue: Hinge at the hip, back flat.

steps.name: Single-leg RDL, 20 lb dumbbell
steps.dose: 3 x 8 each · NEEDS DUMBBELL · TIP: hips square

steps.name: Single-leg RDL, 25 lb dumbbell
steps.dose: 3 x 8 each · NEEDS DUMBBELL · TIP: weight close to the leg

steps.name: Single-leg RDL, 30 lb dumbbell, 3s lowering
steps.dose: 3 x 8 each · NEEDS DUMBBELL · TIP: graduation: no wobble

ladders.name: Machines · Glute kickback machine
ladders.cue: Chest on the pad, hips square. Push through the heel; stop before your back arches.

steps.name: Glute kickback machine, heavier, slow 3s return
steps.dose: 3 x 10 each · NEEDS GLUTE MACHINE · TIP: no swing

steps.name: Glute kickback machine, 2s hold at the top
steps.dose: 3 x 10 each · NEEDS GLUTE MACHINE · TIP: squeeze hard

steps.name: Glute kickback machine, heavier, 2s hold
steps.dose: 3 x 10 each · NEEDS GLUTE MACHINE · TIP: graduation: smooth, back flat

phases.graduation: Reach the last step of every ladder and hit its target.
extraChecks: Wrist rocks: 20 reps, pain-free the next day
One full week with no shoulder pain or slipping feeling
Wall test: right thumb touches the wall overhead with back and ribs flat (needed before chest-to-wall work)
4 weeks of left shoulder work with no instability or giving-out episodes

phases.name: Phase 3: Forearm Headstand
phases.goal: Main goal: forearm headstand at the wall, then a few seconds away from it with a practiced, controlled exit. Plus full L-sit and strict pull-ups.

phases.name: Phase 4: Wall Handstand (optional)
phases.goal: Only if the right-shoulder wall test passes and the left shoulder has been solid for months: wall walks, chest-to-wall holds, wall shoulder taps. No kick-ups or freestanding work.
